name: mspbots-mcp
description: The first MSPbots tool anywhere — readable filters, alias-named resources, full exports, and the KPI history MSPbots itself doesn't keep.

mspbots_api_key.title: MSPBOTS_API_KEY
mspbots_api_key.description: Sets MSPBOTS_API_KEY for the MSPbots MCP server.

mspbots_base_url.title: MSPbots API base URL
mspbots_base_url.description: Base URL for the MSPbots API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

mspbots_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
mspbots_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

mspbots_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
mspbots_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on MSPbots requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile, so every call answers for that customer. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.

mspbots_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP mode
mspbots_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any state-changing call. Leave blank to keep every tool available.

mspbots_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
mspbots_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and the response cache is off. Leave blank to keep the local store.
